The 3-step turn protocol.

AFWE turns replace unsupervised agent edits with a rigorous double-entry protocol: Briefing Pack, Intent Claims, Deterministic Gating.

  1. 1

    Step 1. Begin: Briefing Pack

    Captures a BLAKE3 and AST symbol baseline. Supplies the agent with scoped context: active block pins, living intents, memory records, constraints, and advisory probing guides.

    afwe turn begin "<prompt>" --target <files>
  2. 2

    Step 2. Assume: Pre-Code Claims

    The agent declares intents and verifiable Tree-Sitter AST claims (forbid imports, forbidden patterns, symbol requirements) before modifying code. Pin conflicts trigger immediate REDO.

    afwe turn assume <turn> --file assumptions.json
  3. 3

    Step 3. Commit: Gated Verification

    Attributes changes against baseline, checks for undeclared feature loss, runs comment-blanked AST claims, and commits atomically with an AFWE-Turn receipt trailer.

    afwe turn commit <turn> --summary "..."

Human-readable. Git-committed. Zero vendor lock-in.

AFWE stores architectural knowledge directly inside your repository in .afwe/. It stays with your code, survives tool migrations, and works with every AI coding assistant.

YOUR-REPO/.afwe/ format: afwe/2 
.afwe/
├── afwe.yaml            # Engine policy & test commands
├── blueprint/
│   ├── blueprint.yaml   # Component DAG & boundaries
│   ├── relations.yaml   # Allowed architectural edges
│   └── constraints.yaml # Non-negotiable boundary rules
├── pins/                # Human decisions locked from changes
│   └── pin-auth.yaml    # Block/Confirm/Warn invariants
├── guardrails/
│   ├── active/          # AST import & pattern tripwires
│   ├── passive/         # Natural language context briefs
│   └── manifest.yaml    # BLAKE3 checksums for CI tamper-check
├── intents/             # Living feature DAGs & revisions
├── memory/              # Architectural decision records
│   ├── decisions/       # Why trade-offs were chosen
│   └── terminology/     # Project-specific glossary
└── turns/               # Verified turn ledger receipts
    └── t0001.yaml       # Verbatim prompt, claims, git hash
No hidden databases
Inspectable with git diff. Every turn, pin, constraint, and architectural evolution is a clear YAML diff in your pull requests. Review them like code.
Codebase pin budget
Prevents rule sprawl. Pin budgets automatically scale with codebase size. Slider controls keep rules tight so agents do not drown in obsolete constraints.
Feature restoration
Recover silent feature losses. When an agent accidentally deletes code 15 prompts later, run afwe timeline restore to execute an automated 3-way merge against the last good turn.
Tripwire materialization
Enforce in local hooks and CI. Run afwe materialize --apply to generate chained git pre-commit hooks and GitHub Actions workflows verified against BLAKE3 manifests.
